AccountLookup.description: Every record that matches; more than one is worth a look.
AccountLookup.title: AccountLookup

CivRecord.description: A civ6 leader token, or a civ7 civ token, and how it went.
CivRecord.title: CivRecord

DraftRequest.description: How many pools, their sizes, the age and the host's bans.
DraftRequest.title: DraftRequest

HistoryGame.description:
One approved game, as the player saw it. A placement of 0 is first;
in a team game it is the team's place.
HistoryGame.title: HistoryGame

LeaderPick.description: A blind pick: a leader, and a civ where the pool has civs.
LeaderPick.title: LeaderPick

LobbyBallot.description:
The players' reactions: per setting put to the vote, the players backing
each option; per leader, the players banning it.
LobbyBallot.title: LobbyBallot

LobbyCancel.description: A lobby or vote is cancelled by its code, by its host or by staff.
LobbyCancel.title: LobbyCancel

LobbyEdit.description:
The host's whole edit: the size, the settings with the draft mode (all
of them once live), every leader banned, and players moved or removed.
LobbyEdit.title: LobbyEdit

LobbyLive.description: The post that opens the lobby to players, edited in place from then on.
LobbyLive.title: LobbyLive

LobbyPool.description: A player's draft, or a team's when `player_id` is empty.
LobbyPool.title: LobbyPool

LobbyRequest.description: /lobby host. The host is the acting player; the settings start at their defaults.
LobbyRequest.title: LobbyRequest

MapRecord.description: Games on a map, those whose rating went up, and first places.
MapRecord.title: MapRecord

RegistrationMethod.description: How a registration's account ownership was established.
RegistrationMethod.title: RegistrationMethod

ResetStatsResponseV2.description:
A reset's answer: the stats as they stood before it, and as they start
again after it -- every mode that had a row, back at the starting rating.
ResetStatsResponseV2.title: ResetStatsResponseV2

SeasonPreview.description:
The open season, what comes next, and the season records per collection
that a change would save and clear.
SeasonPreview.title: SeasonPreview

SeasonRolled.description: A season change: what closed, what opened, and the backup folder's name.
SeasonRolled.title: SeasonRolled

SeatPatchIn.description: One seat's requested changes. Absent means unchanged.
SeatPatchIn.title: SeatPatchIn

Standing.description: An account's record with Lady Justice.
Standing.title: Standing

StartNextSeason.description: The season the caller saw open; the change happens only if it still is.
StartNextSeason.title: StartNextSeason

StatsSummary.description:
Games by map and the most played civs, since the last reset if any.
A win is a game whose rating went up; a first is first place.
StatsSummary.title: StatsSummary

SuspensionCleared.description:
A suspension ended, with the roles the bot should give back; `suspended`
is the record after the call, so a repeat can tell it ended or never did.
SuspensionCleared.title: SuspensionCleared

TwoKRegistrationBody.description: Civ7 on 2K, registered by the player without staff.
TwoKRegistrationBody.title: TwoKRegistrationBody

UploadResponse.description: A response model drops undeclared keys, so the duplicate flags are declared.
UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse

VoteBallot.description:
The players' reactions: per setting, the players backing each option;
per leader or civ, the players banning it.
VoteBallot.title: VoteBallot

VoteMessages.description:
Where the vote is posted: the channel, and its status, setting and ban
messages by name.
VoteMessages.title: VoteMessages

VotePlace.description:
Where the bans vote, then the blind picks, are posted: the channel, the
status message, and one message per setting put to the vote.
VotePlace.title: VotePlace

VoteRequest.description:
/vote: the players from a voice channel, the game, and the bans its
starter chose; everything else is voted on.
VoteRequest.title: VoteRequest
